articles.title: Bitcoin miners were hijacked and their BTC rewards redirected to an attacker
articles.snippet: Luxor said just over a dozen customers were affected and will be reimbursed after their machines were redirected to another mining pool.

articles.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
articles.snippet: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

articles.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
articles.snippet: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”
